summary: Backend-only validation of Budgy v3.9.0 locale-aware endpoints (Coach IA, Email Parse, Scanner OCR). Ran full pytest suite: 144 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed (10.35s). Smoke tested /api/health (200, version 3.9.0) and /api/iap/health (200, expected shape) via public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Zero regression on pre-existing 126 tests; all 18 new locale tests in test_v390_locale_endpoints.py PASS. Locale directive per language (fr/en/de/it) verified in system prompt; chat_sessions namespaced by (user_id, locale, session_id); DATA INTEGRITY - NEVER TRANSLATE clauses present in OCR + Email prompts; stable UPPER_SNAKE_CASE error codes (OCR_FAILED, IMAGE_TOO_SMALL, INVALID_BASE64, LLM_NOT_CONFIGURED, EMAIL_PARSE_FAILED) confirmed in code. Apple/IAP endpoints untouched.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py exceeds 1500 lines - consider modularization in a future refactor (non-blocking for v3.9.0).
build_system_prompt(locale) correctly appends LANGUAGE DIRECTIVE to SYSTEM_PROMPT_BASE (server.py:249-252).
chat_sessions keyed by namespaced tuple (user_id, locale, session_id) prevents cross-locale bleed (server.py:301).
DATA INTEGRITY - NEVER TRANSLATE clauses present in both OCR (server.py:765) and Email (server.py:956) prompts.
All error paths return stable UPPER_SNAKE_CASE codes (LLM_NOT_CONFIGURED, IMAGE_TOO_SMALL, INVALID_BASE64, OCR_FAILED, EMAIL_PARSE_FAILED).

success_rate.frontend: not tested (out of scope per request)

seed_data_creation: None - locale tests use FakeChat monkeypatch and auth dependency override.

Frontend validation was performed statically by main agent (npm run audit:i18n / check:i18n / tsc --noEmit) and was explicitly out of scope for this run.
